transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

I guess… I’m here because I’ve just been feeling really low most days. Like I wake up and there’s this heavy gray feeling already there. Even at work with the crew, or around my kids, I can’t really shake it. I’m just kind of going through the motions.
How long have you been feeling this way most days?
About… a little over three years. Maybe three years and a few months. It started after the groundskeeping contract changed and our days got longer. Since then it’s just kind of been most days.
Have you ever had periods where your mood was unusually high, irritable, or you felt overly energetic, even if it didn’t last very long?
I don’t think so. I mean, I get irritated sometimes, but not like… overly energetic or in a good mood for no reason. Nothing like that that I can think of.
Have you ever had a period lasting at least two weeks where you felt so down, hopeless, or lost interest in most things that it was hard to function normally?

Yeah… I mean, most days I wake up already feeling like there’s this gray weight on me. It’s hard to shake, even when I’m working with the crew or with my kids. I’m just… kind of there, going through the motions.
Have you noticed that you’ve lost interest in things you used to enjoy, like hobbies, time with family, or activities with your kids?
I don’t know… maybe. I still do things with them when I need to. It just doesn’t feel the same, I guess.
Have you ever had a time when you felt so depressed that it was difficult to get through your day, like you couldn’t get out of bed or take care of your usual responsibilities?

Yeah… not like I just stay in bed all day, but it’s been hard. I’ve been missing details when I’m planning jobs, getting behind on the crew paperwork. And I’ve stopped showing up for some of the community garden stuff and music gatherings I used to help with. People have had to cover for me more than they used to.

Have you had any recent periods—say in the past year—where your low mood got significantly worse, and you felt completely overwhelmed, even struggling to do basic tasks like work or taking care of your kids?

Yeah… it’s gotten worse this past year. I’m still showing up, mostly, but I’ve been missing things when I plan jobs, falling behind on the crew paperwork. And I’ve kind of stopped going to the community garden and the music stuff I used to help with. People have had to step in… which doesn’t feel good.
Have you had a depressed mood most of the time, nearly every day, for at least two years?
Yeah… I guess so. Most days I wake up and it’s already there, like this gray weight. Even when I’m at work or with my kids, I’m mostly just… going through the motions.
Has there ever been a time in the past three years when your mood improved significantly for a couple of months or more, where you felt more like your usual self?

Not really, no. I mean… maybe a decent week here or there, but not a couple months. It’s been about three years now—three years and a few months—since that groundskeeping contract changed and the longer days kind of took over. I haven’t really felt like myself for that long.
Have you had any period in the past three years where your mood stayed better for at least two months, where you felt more like your usual self?
No… not for that long. It’s been pretty steady for about three years and a few months now, since that groundskeeping contract changed and the longer days kind of took over.
Have there been any times in the past three years when you felt significantly better for a period of at least two months, where you felt more like your usual self?

No… I don’t think so. It’s been about three years and a few months now, since the groundskeeping schedule changed and the longer days kind of took over. I haven’t really had a two-month stretch where I felt like myself.
